name: Primordial Rage
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting, polymorph]; Level alchemist 4, bard 3, bloodrager 4, mesmerist 3, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, summoner 4, unchained summoner 4, witch 4

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as rage except if the target does not have natural attacks, they gain a 1d6 bite attack in addition to the normal benefits of the rage. If the target has natural attacks, their damage dice are increased by 1 step while the spell is active in addition to the rage benefits.
